title_sq: Shitet apartament 1+1 te rezidenca Ballada, Farke!
description_sq:
Shitet apartament 1+1, 43 m2, kati 2 te rezidenca Ballada.
Mundesi rezervimi me 1.000€
Pagese 20% realizohet me fillimin e punimeve dhe 80% ne momentin qe apartamenti eshte i perfunduar totalisht me dyer, dritare, grila, laminat AC5 dhe tualet i kompletuar me hidrosanitare inkaso.
Mundesi kreditimi 80% me kolateralin e kompanise. Rezidenca Ballada eshte e pozicionuar prane liqenit te Farkes dhe Unazes se Madhe dhe ofron nje jetese te qete prane natyres por me akses te menjehershem me Tiranen. Rezidenca Ballada ka hapesira te dedikuara per kembesore te vecuara nga rruget e makinave.
title_en: 1+1 apartment for sale in Ballada residence, Farke!
description_en: 1+1 apartment for sale, 43 m2, 2nd floor, Ballada residence. Possibility of booking with €1,000. Payment of 20% is made at the start of the works and 80% when the apartment is completely finished with doors, windows, shutters, AC5 laminate and a toilet complete with a flush toilet. Possibility of 80% credit with the company's collateral. The Ballada Residence is located near Farka Lake and the Great Ring Road and offers a quiet lifestyle close to nature but with immediate access to Tirana. The Ballada residence has spaces dedicated to pedestrians separated from the car roads.
